"""E-004, finish line 2: no page nests a comment more than five levels deep; a 'continue this thread' link opens the
deeper branch on its own page, which links back to the report and takes replies; each comment with replies has a
toggle that, in a browser and by the site's own script, hides and shows what is beneath it; the report path's
Content-Security-Policy still forbids every script.

Comments are posted through POST /reports/<slug>/comments (body=..., parent=<n>) from the page that shows comment n,
and shown as elements id="comment-<n>" nested as they answer one another. The toggle is tried in a headless Chrome or
Edge of the test's own: inside a comment's element, outside its replies', a button, summary, link or role=button that
says collapse, expand, hide, show, toggle, or - / + -- clicked once, every reply beneath stops rendering; again, back.

How it runs: `go build ./cmd/hband`, started on a free port with a fresh data folder and the HBAND_* settings in
Product, spoken to as the VPS proxy forwards a browser, with a stand-in GitHub of its own. Every POST carries the CSRF
token of the page it is sent from (a hidden field named like csrf/xsrf/token, or a csrf meta tag as X-CSRF-Token); a
count is a number beside its label ("3 likes", "Likes: 3", a thumb and 3).
"""
import base64, glob, html.parser, http.client, json, os, re, secrets, shutil, socket, subprocess, sys, tempfile, threading
import time, unittest, warnings
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
from urllib.parse import parse_qsl, urlencode, urljoin, urlsplit

warnings.simplefilter("ignore")  # a failure speaks by its message: a traceback or warning would open this file to quote it
threading.excepthook, sys.excepthook = (lambda a: None), (lambda k, v, tb: print(f"{k.__name__}: {v}", file=sys.stderr))
[s.reconfigure(errors="backslashreplace") for s in (sys.stdout, sys.stderr)]
ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))
BASE, EVIL, EXE, OWNER_ID = "https://hband.test", "https://evil.example", ".exe" if os.name == "nt" else "", 4242
UA = "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/131.0 Safari/537.36"


def check(ok, why):
    if not ok:
        raise AssertionError(why)


def mark(word):  # letters only, so no count is ever read into it
    return word + "-" + "".join(secrets.choice("bcdfghjkmnpqrstvwxz") for _ in range(10))


def build(work):  # the product: what `go build ./cmd/hband` makes of this tree
    go = [g for g in (shutil.which("go"), os.path.join(os.environ.get("GOROOT") or "-", "bin", "go" + EXE),
                      r"C:\Program Files\Go\bin\go.exe", *glob.glob(os.path.expanduser("~/sdk/go*/bin/go" + EXE))) if g and os.path.isfile(g)]
    check(go, "no Go toolchain (PATH, GOROOT, Program Files, ~/sdk) to build ./cmd/hband with")
    run = subprocess.run([go[0], "build", "-o", work + "/hband" + EXE, "./cmd/hband"], cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True,
                         errors="replace", env=dict(os.environ, CGO_ENABLED="0"), timeout=780)
    check(run.returncode == 0, f"`go build ./cmd/hband` exited {run.returncode}: {(run.stdout + run.stderr)[:2000]}")
    return [work + "/hband" + EXE]


class GitHub(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):  # stand-in GitHub: a code the test handed out buys a token, the token its account (/user)
    log_message = lambda self, *a: None

    def answer(self, status, body, kind="application/json"):
        self.send_response(status)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", kind)
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body.encode())

    def do_POST(self):
        sent = self.rfile.read(int(self.headers.get("Content-Length") or 0)).decode() + "&" + urlsplit(self.path).query
        who, token, js = self.server.codes.pop(dict(parse_qsl(sent)).get("code"), None), secrets.token_hex(16), "json" in self.headers.get("Accept", "")
        if who is None:
            return self.answer(400, '{"error": "bad_verification_code"}')
        self.server.tokens[token], got = who, {"access_token": token, "token_type": "bearer", "scope": ""}
        self.answer(200, json.dumps(got) if js else urlencode(got), "application/json" if js else "application/x-www-form-urlencoded")

    def do_GET(self):
        who = self.server.tokens.get((self.headers.get("Authorization") or "-").split()[-1])
        self.answer(200, json.dumps(dict(who, name=who["login"], type="User"))) if who else self.answer(401, '{"message": "Bad credentials"}')


class Node:
    def __init__(self, tag, attrs, parent):
        self.tag, self.attrs, self.parent, self.kids, self.data = tag, dict(attrs), parent, [], ""

    def walk(self):
        for k in self.kids:
            yield k
            yield from k.walk()

    def text(self, skip=lambda n: False):  # what it shows a person, less the elements `skip` names
        if self.tag == "#text":
            return self.data
        if self.tag in ("script", "style", "template", "textarea", "title") or skip(self):
            return ""
        return " ".join(" ".join(k.text(skip).split()) for k in self.kids).strip()


def dom(text):  # a page as a tree of elements and texts, forgiving of the end tags HTML leaves out
    at = [Node("#root", (), None)]

    class Reader(html.parser.HTMLParser):
        def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
            while len(at) > 1 and at[-1].tag == tag in ("li", "p", "tr", "td", "option"):
                at.pop()
            at[-1].kids.append(Node(tag, ((k, v or "") for k, v in attrs), at[-1]))
            if tag not in ("area", "base", "br", "col", "embed", "hr", "img", "input", "link", "meta", "source", "wbr"):
                at.append(at[-1].kids[-1])

        def handle_endtag(self, tag):
            while any(n.tag == tag for n in at[1:]) and at.pop().tag != tag:
                pass

        def handle_data(self, data):
            at[-1].kids.append(Node("#text", (), at[-1]))
            at[-1].kids[-1].data = data

    reader = Reader(convert_charrefs=True)
    reader.feed(text)
    reader.close()
    return at[0]


def chain(n):  # the node and every element around it
    return chain(n.parent) + [n] if n is not None else []


class Page:
    def __init__(self, url, r):
        self.url, self.status, self.msg, self.text, self._dom = url, r.status, r.msg, r.read().decode("utf-8", "replace"), None

    def header(self, name):
        return self.msg.get(name) or ""

    @property
    def dom(self):
        self._dom = self._dom or dom(self.text)
        return self._dom


def csrf(page):  # the page's CSRF token: hidden fields named like one, or a csrf meta tag (sent as X-CSRF-Token)
    hid = {n.attrs["name"]: n.attrs.get("value", "") for n in list(page.dom.walk())[::-1] if n.tag == "input"
           and n.attrs.get("type", "").lower() == "hidden" and re.search("csrf|xsrf|token", n.attrs.get("name", ""), re.I)}
    meta = [n.attrs.get("content", "") for n in page.dom.walk() if n.tag == "meta" and re.search("csrf|xsrf", n.attrs.get("name", ""), re.I)]
    return hid, ({"X-CSRF-Token": meta[0]} if meta else {})


class Browser:
    """A visitor as the VPS proxy forwards it (cookies, X-Forwarded-For, https, the public host); `seen`: every answer it got."""
    def __init__(self, port, login=None):
        self.port, self.login, self.jar, self.seen = port, login, {}, []

    def send(self, method, url, body=None, headers=None):
        u, c = urlsplit(urljoin(BASE + "/", url)), http.client.HTTPConnection("127.0.0.1", self.port, timeout=60)
        h = {"Host": u.netloc, "Accept": "text/html,*/*", "User-Agent": UA, "X-Forwarded-For": "192.0.2.10", "X-Real-IP": "192.0.2.10",
             "X-Forwarded-Proto": "https", **({"Cookie": "; ".join(f"{k}={v}" for k, v in self.jar.items())} if self.jar else {}), **(headers or {})}
        try:
            c.request(method, (u.path or "/") + (f"?{u.query}" if u.query else ""), body, h)
            page = Page(u.geturl(), c.getresponse())
        finally:
            c.close()
        for line in page.msg.get_all("Set-Cookie") or []:
            name, _, value = line.split(";")[0].strip().partition("=")
            self.jar.pop(name, None)
            if value and not re.search(r"max-age=(0|-)|expires=[^;]*19[67]\d", line, re.I):
                self.jar[name] = value
        self.seen.append(page)
        return page

    def go(self, url, method="GET", body=None, headers=None):  # where the browser lands, after this site's own redirects
        page = self.send(method, url, body, headers)
        for _ in range(8):
            to = urljoin(page.url, page.header("Location"))
            if not (300 <= page.status < 400 and page.header("Location")) or urlsplit(to).netloc != "hband.test":
                break
            page = self.send("GET", to)
        return page

    def post(self, path, fields, page, forged=False):
        # a form POST with the CSRF token of `page`; `forged`: sent by another site, which sets no header of its own
        hid, meta = csrf(page)
        h = {"Origin": EVIL, "Referer": EVIL + "/", "Sec-Fetch-Site": "cross-site"} if forged else {
            "Origin": BASE, "Referer": page.url, "Sec-Fetch-Site": "same-origin", **meta}
        return self.go(path, "POST", urlencode({**hid, **fields}).encode(), {"Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded", **h})


class Product:
    """The server this tree builds: a free port, a fresh data folder, a stand-in GitHub, the owner pinned by user ID."""
    def __init__(self):
        self.work, self.proc, self.hub = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="hband-acceptance-"), None, ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), GitHub)
        self.hub.codes, self.hub.tokens, self.hub.daemon_threads, self.hub.handle_error = {}, {}, True, lambda *a: None
        threading.Thread(target=self.hub.serve_forever, daemon=True).start()
        self.url, self.log = f"http://127.0.0.1:{self.hub.server_address[1]}", open(self.work + "/server.log", "wb")
        self.owner = self.account(OWNER_ID, "report-author")
        try:
            command = build(self.work)
            with socket.socket() as s:
                s.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
                self.port = s.getsockname()[1]
            os.makedirs(self.work + "/data")
            self.proc = subprocess.Popen(command, cwd=self.work, stdout=self.log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, env=dict(
                os.environ, HBAND_ADDR=f"127.0.0.1:{self.port}", HBAND_DATA_DIR=self.work + "/data", HBAND_BASE_URL=BASE,
                HBAND_OWNER_GITHUB_ID=str(OWNER_ID), HBAND_GITHUB_CLIENT_ID="hband-test", HBAND_GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET="hband-test-secret",
                HBAND_GITHUB_URL=self.url, HBAND_GITHUB_API_URL=self.url, HBAND_MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES=str(10 << 20), HBAND_TRUSTED_PROXIES="127.0.0.1"))
            for _ in range(240):
                check(self.proc.poll() is None, f"the server exited ({self.proc.returncode}): {self.said()}")
                try:
                    Browser(self.port).send("GET", "/")
                    return
                except OSError:
                    time.sleep(0.25)
            check(False, f"the server did not answer in 60 s: {self.said()}")
        except BaseException:
            self.stop()
            raise

    def said(self):
        self.log.flush()
        with open(self.log.name, "rb") as fh:
            return fh.read()[-2000:].decode("utf-8", "replace")

    def stop(self):
        if self.proc and self.proc.poll() is None:
            self.proc.kill()
            self.proc.wait(30)
        self.log.close()
        self.hub.shutdown()
        self.hub.server_close()
        shutil.rmtree(self.work, ignore_errors=True)

    def account(self, uid, login=None):  # a GitHub account: user ID, login, avatar address
        return {"id": uid, "login": login or mark("reader").lower(), "avatar_url": f"https://avatars.example/u/{uid}?v=4"}

    def sign_in(self, who):  # a browser signed in through GitHub as `who`, from GET /auth/github/login
        b = Browser(self.port, who["login"])
        got = self.approve(b, b.send("GET", "/auth/github/login"), who)
        check(got.status < 400, f"signing in as {who['login']} landed on {got.status}: {got.text[:300]}")
        return b

    def approve(self, b, start, who):
        # GitHub's half of the sign-in `start` began (a redirect to its authorize page): it approves `who`; where `b` lands
        to = start.header("Location")
        check(300 <= start.status < 400 and to.startswith(self.url + "/login/oauth/authorize"),
              f"{start.url} answered {start.status} {to!r}, not a redirect to GitHub's authorize page")
        asked, code = dict(parse_qsl(urlsplit(to).query)), secrets.token_hex(10)
        self.hub.codes[code], back = who, asked.get("redirect_uri") or BASE + "/auth/github/callback"
        return b.go(back + ("&" if "?" in back else "?") + urlencode({"code": code, "state": asked.get("state", "")}))

    def publish(self, owner, slug, title):  # the owner uploads a report as the admin page's form does, published now
        hid, meta = csrf(owner.go("/admin"))
        edge, doc = secrets.token_hex(12), f"<!doctype html><html><head><title>{title}</title></head><body><h1>{title}</h1></body></html>"
        body = "".join(f'--{edge}\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name="{k}"\r\n\r\n{v}\r\n' for k, v in {
            **hid, "title": title, "slug": slug, "status": "published"}.items()) + f'--{edge}\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; ' \
            f'name="file"; filename="{slug}.html"\r\nContent-Type: text/html\r\n\r\n{doc}\r\n--{edge}--\r\n'
        got = owner.go("/admin/reports", "POST", body.encode(), {**meta, "Origin": BASE, "Referer": BASE + "/admin",
                                                                "Content-Type": f"multipart/form-data; boundary={edge}"})
        check(got.status < 400, f"publishing {slug} answered {got.status}: {got.text[:300]}")
        time.sleep(1.1)  # a second apart, so the newest is known


class Case(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.app = Product()
        self.addCleanup(self.app.stop)


CID = re.compile(r"comment-(\d+)")


def shown(page):  # {id: element} for each comment the page shows, an element id="comment-<n>", in page order
    return {CID.fullmatch(n.attrs["id"]).group(1): n for n in page.dom.walk() if CID.fullmatch(n.attrs.get("id", ""))}


def own(n):  # a comment's own text: its element's, less the comments nested in it
    return " ".join(k.text(lambda x: CID.fullmatch(x.attrs.get("id", ""))) for k in n.kids)


def find(page, text):  # the id of the comment whose own text holds `text`, or None
    return next((i for i, n in shown(page).items() if text in own(n)), None)


def depth(n):  # how many comments hold this one, itself counted
    return sum(1 for a in chain(n) if CID.fullmatch(a.attrs.get("id", "")))


def say(b, slug, text, parent=None, page=None):
    """`b` posts `text` from `page` (default /reports/<slug>): POST /reports/<slug>/comments, answering comment `parent`.
    The new comment's id where that page shows it."""
    page = page or b.go(f"/reports/{slug}")
    got = b.post(f"/reports/{slug}/comments", {"body": text, **({"parent": parent} if parent else {})}, page)
    check(got.status < 400, f"{b.login}'s comment on {slug} answered {got.status}: {got.text[:200]}")
    return find(b.go(page.url), text)


def mine(n):  # the nodes of a comment's element that are its own, not its nested comments'
    for k in n.kids:
        if not CID.fullmatch(k.attrs.get("id", "")):
            yield k
            yield from mine(k)


FOLD = r"""(async id => {
  const top = document.getElementById("comment-" + id);
  if (!top) return "the page has no comment-" + id;
  const holder = e => { for (let x = e; x; x = x.parentElement) if (/^comment-\d+$/.test(x.id)) return x; };
  const nested = [...top.querySelectorAll("[id]")].filter(e => e !== top && /^comment-\d+$/.test(e.id));
  const said = e => [e.textContent, e.getAttribute("aria-label"), e.getAttribute("title")].join(" ").trim();
  const toggle = [...top.querySelectorAll("button, summary, a, [role=button]")].find(e => holder(e) === top &&
    /collapse|expand|hide|show|toggle|^\[?\s*[-+\u2212\u2013]\s*\]?$/i.test(said(e)));
  if (!toggle) return "comment-" + id + " has no toggle of its own";
  const seen = () => nested.map(e => e.getClientRects().length > 0 && getComputedStyle(e).visibility !== "hidden");
  const pause = () => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 400));
  const before = seen(); toggle.click(); await pause(); const folded = seen(); toggle.click(); await pause();
  return JSON.stringify({before, folded, after: seen()});
})("ID")"""


class Chrome:
    """A headless Chrome or Edge of the test's own. The test answers its every request (DevTools' Fetch domain) by
    sending it on to the product as the VPS proxy does, so the page is https://hband.test as it is in use."""
    def __init__(self, port):
        exe = [p for p in (r"C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe", r"C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft\Edge\Application\msedge.exe",
                           *map(shutil.which, ("chrome", "msedge", "chromium", "google-chrome"))) if p and os.path.isfile(p)]
        check(exe, "no Chrome or Edge to open the page in")
        self.prof, self.n, self.b, self.buf = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="hband-chrome-"), 0, Browser(port), b""
        self.proc = subprocess.Popen([exe[0], "--headless=new", "--no-first-run", "--no-default-browser-check", "--remote-debugging-port=0",
                                      f"--user-data-dir={self.prof}", "about:blank"], stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
        for _ in range(120):
            try:
                with open(os.path.join(self.prof, "DevToolsActivePort")) as fh:
                    c = http.client.HTTPConnection("127.0.0.1", int(fh.read().split()[0]), timeout=30)
                c.request("GET", "/json/list")
                u = urlsplit(next(t["webSocketDebuggerUrl"] for t in json.loads(c.getresponse().read()) if t["type"] == "page"))
                break
            except (OSError, ValueError, IndexError, StopIteration):
                time.sleep(0.25)
        else:
            check(False, "the browser opened no DevTools port")
        self.s = socket.create_connection((u.hostname, u.port), timeout=60)
        self.s.sendall(f"GET {u.path} HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: {u.netloc}\r\nUpgrade: websocket\r\nConnection: Upgrade\r\nSec-WebSocket-Version: 13\r\n"
                       f"Sec-WebSocket-Key: {base64.b64encode(os.urandom(16)).decode()}\r\n\r\n".encode())
        while b"\r\n\r\n" not in self.buf:
            self.buf += self.s.recv(4096)
        self.buf = self.buf.split(b"\r\n\r\n", 1)[1]
        self.call("Fetch.enable", patterns=[{"urlPattern": "*"}])

    def read(self, n):
        while len(self.buf) < n:
            more = self.s.recv(1 << 16)
            check(more, "the browser closed DevTools")
            self.buf += more
        out, self.buf = self.buf[:n], self.buf[n:]
        return out

    def put(self, method, params):  # one DevTools message, as a masked WebSocket text frame
        self.n += 1
        data, key = json.dumps({"id": self.n, "method": method, "params": params}).encode(), os.urandom(4)
        size = bytes([0x80 | len(data)]) if len(data) < 126 else b"\xfe" + len(data).to_bytes(2, "big") if len(data) < 65536 else b"\xff" + len(data).to_bytes(8, "big")
        self.s.sendall(b"\x81" + size + key + bytes(c ^ key[i % 4] for i, c in enumerate(data)))
        return self.n

    def call(self, method, **params):
        mine = self.put(method, params)
        while True:
            msg, fin = b"", 0
            while not fin:
                head = self.read(2)
                fin, size = head[0] & 0x80, head[1] & 0x7F
                msg += self.read(int.from_bytes(self.read(2 if size == 126 else 8), "big") if size > 125 else size)
            m = json.loads(msg)
            if m.get("method") == "Fetch.requestPaused":
                self.answer(m["params"])
            elif m.get("id") == mine:
                check("error" not in m, f"DevTools {method}: {m.get('error')}")
                return m.get("result", {})

    def answer(self, p):  # the page's request, sent on to the product; its answer handed back
        if urlsplit(p["request"]["url"]).netloc != "hband.test":
            return self.put("Fetch.failRequest", {"requestId": p["requestId"], "errorReason": "BlockedByClient"})
        got = self.b.send(p["request"]["method"], p["request"]["url"])
        self.put("Fetch.fulfillRequest", {"requestId": p["requestId"], "responseCode": got.status, "body": base64.b64encode(got.text.encode()).decode(),
                 "responseHeaders": [{"name": k, "value": v} for k, v in got.msg.items() if k.lower() not in ("content-length", "connection", "transfer-encoding")]})

    def js(self, expr):
        got = self.call("Runtime.evaluate", expression=expr, returnByValue=True, awaitPromise=True)
        check("exceptionDetails" not in got, f"the page's JavaScript failed: {got.get('exceptionDetails')}")
        return got["result"].get("value")

    def open(self, url):
        self.call("Page.navigate", url=url)
        for _ in range(120):
            if self.js("document.readyState") == "complete":
                return
            time.sleep(0.25)
        check(False, f"{url} did not finish loading")

    def close(self):
        try:
            self.put("Browser.close", {})
            self.proc.wait(15)
        except Exception:
            self.proc.kill()
        shutil.rmtree(self.prof, ignore_errors=True)


class E004DeepThreadsTest(Case):
    def test_threads_nest_at_most_five_deep_continue_on_a_branch_page_and_fold_in_a_browser(self):
        app, a = self.app, "e004-branch-alpha"
        owner = app.sign_in(app.owner)
        app.publish(owner, "e004-branch-beta", "Beta Notes")
        app.publish(owner, a, "Alpha Notes")
        rs, texts, ids = [app.sign_in(app.account(7501 + i)) for i in range(2)], [mark("Level") for _ in range(8)], []
        for k in range(6):  # levels 1 to 6, each answered from the report page; the sixth is not shown there
            ids.append(say(rs[k % 2], a, texts[k], ids[-1] if ids else None))
        page = Browser(app.port).go(f"/reports/{a}")
        got = shown(page)
        self.assertTrue(all(ids[:5]) and texts[5] not in page.text, f"/reports/{a} should show levels 1 to 5 and not level 6")
        self.assertEqual([depth(got[i]) for i in ids[:5]], [1, 2, 3, 4, 5], "the five levels are not nested one in another")
        more = [x for x in got[ids[4]].walk() if x.tag == "a" and re.search(r"continue\s+this\s+thread", x.text(), re.I)]
        self.assertTrue(more, f"comment-{ids[4]}, five levels deep, has no 'continue this thread' link")
        branch = urljoin(page.url, more[0].attrs.get("href", ""))
        for k in (6, 7):  # levels 7 and 8, answered from the branch page
            there = rs[k % 2].go(branch)
            self.assertIn(f"/reports/{a}/comments", there.text, f"the branch page {branch} offers a signed-in reader no reply form")
            self.assertTrue(find(there, texts[k - 1]), f"the branch page {branch} does not show level {k}")
            self.assertTrue(say(rs[k % 2], a, texts[k], find(there, texts[k - 1]), there), "a reply sent from the branch page does not show there")
        there = Browser(app.port).go(branch)
        self.assertTrue(all(find(there, t) for t in texts[5:]), "the branch page does not show levels 6 to 8")
        self.assertTrue([x for x in there.dom.walk() if x.tag == "a" and re.split("[?#]", urljoin(there.url, x.attrs.get("href", "")))[0]
                         == f"{BASE}/reports/{a}"], "the branch page has no link back to the full report")
        for p in (Browser(app.port).go(f"/reports/{a}"), Browser(app.port).go("/"), there):
            self.assertLessEqual(max(map(depth, shown(p).values()), default=0), 5, f"{p.url} nests a comment more than five levels deep")
            self.assertTrue(p is there or not [t for t in texts[5:] if t in p.text], f"{p.url} shows a reply deeper than five levels")
        side = say(rs[0], a, mark("Aside"))
        under = say(rs[1], a, mark("Under"), side)
        say(rs[0], a, mark("Below"), under)
        page = Browser(app.port).go(f"/reports/{a}")
        scripts = [urljoin(page.url, x.attrs["src"]) for x in page.dom.walk() if x.tag == "script" and x.attrs.get("src")]
        self.assertTrue([s for s in scripts if urlsplit(s).netloc == "hband.test" and Browser(app.port).go(s).status == 200],
                        "the report page loads no script from the site's own path")
        frames = [urljoin(page.url, x.attrs.get("src", "")) for x in page.dom.walk() if x.tag == "iframe"]
        self.assertTrue(frames, "the report page embeds no report")
        csp = Browser(app.port).go(frames[0]).header("Content-Security-Policy")
        rules = {p.split()[0].lower(): [s.lower() for s in p.split()[1:]] for p in csp.split(";") if p.split()}
        self.assertTrue(all(rules.get(k, rules.get("script-src", rules.get("default-src"))) == ["'none'"] for k in
                            ("script-src", "script-src-elem", "script-src-attr")), f"the report path's CSP does not forbid every script: {csp!r}")
        tab = Chrome(app.port)
        try:
            tab.open(f"{BASE}/reports/{a}")
            for cid in (ids[0], side, under):
                said = tab.js(FOLD.replace("ID", cid))
                self.assertTrue(said.startswith("{"), said)
                seen = json.loads(said)
                self.assertTrue(seen["before"] and all(seen["before"]) and not any(seen["folded"]) and all(seen["after"]),
                                f"comment-{cid}'s toggle does not hide and then show the replies beneath it: {seen}")
        finally:
            tab.close()


class Plain(unittest.TextTestResult):  # a failure is told by its message alone
    _exc_info_to_string = lambda self, err, test: f"{err[0].__name__}: {err[1]}"


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(not unittest.TextTestRunner(resultclass=Plain, verbosity=2).run(
        unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromModule(sys.modules[__name__])).wasSuccessful())
